links.outcome: Whether row-level patient data stayed local while an external LLM reasoned
links.effect: External LLM received zero row-level patient data while all core analytic workflows ran via local R execution in a single MASLD replication; no comparator.
links.quote: The external large language model actively clarified analytical prompts while receiving zero row-level patient data.

unlisted_practices: Decoupling cloud LLM reasoning from local code execution for statistical analysis
Human-in-the-loop requirement refinement for judgment-dependent analytic decisions

screen.reason: The study develops and validates a privacy-preserving agentic LLM architecture (local code execution coupled with cloud LLM reasoning via RAG) to conduct clinical statistical analysis without exposing row-level data. It does not compare outcomes with vs without a specific deployment safeguard practice.
